author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Finds a safe live Twitch raid destination from creator or viewer-suggested preferred channels, followed-live channels, or the current category, then requires creator confirmation before starting the raid.
changelog: 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.0: added a bounded stream-scoped viewer suggestion queue backed by a specific Twitch Channel Points reward, transactional fulfill/refund handling, one-suggestion-per-viewer protection, and automatic offline/next-stream clearing; also aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.0: initial release with configurable discovery order, bounded Twitch searches, preferred-channel batching, viewer/language/category/tag filters, similar-size preference, stream-based recent-raid protection, shuffle-without-repeats, expiring suggestions, creator Confirm/Cancel actions, optional advanced automatic mode, editable chat output, and a styled Next Stop overlay card.

manifest.name: Raid Scout
installationSteps: Import the separate Raid Scout Streamer.bot package.
Keep its Controller action triggerless and approve only that stable action ID for this add-on.
Attach Suggest, Confirm, and Cancel only to creator-controlled hotkeys, deck buttons, or operator commands.
Optionally configure one Streamer.bot-owned Twitch reward ID for stream-scoped viewer suggestions.
Configure preferred channels and filters, then test Suggest before enabling automatic mode.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded private suggestion and raid history remains preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded discovery, filtering, non-repeating selection, and creator-confirmed Twitch raids.
